title: Message/changes puts ALL state-version changes in created; updated messages appear as new creates
description: MessageChangesHandler (message.rs): get_changes_since_ordered returns rows for both new inserts AND delivery_state/read_at updates (both advance state_version). All returned IDs are placed in created with updated hardcoded to []. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires that IDs of pre-existing objects that changed appear in updated, not created. A conforming client will try to create a duplicate local object for each updated message. Fix: store a created_at_version column on messages (set at INSERT, never updated) and use it to distinguish created (created_at_version > since) from updated (state_version > since but created_at_version <= since).
